intent: Install a superset of the interactive Obsidian features shown in the reference videos: graph workspaces, advanced canvas, dashboards, templates, tasks, project memory, and optional agentic AI.

interactive-safe.description: Default vault profile. Enables visual/project/dashboard plugins but avoids desktop-only agent/API plugins.

desktop-full.description: Desktop-only. Enables the full visual + agentic stack after manual review and successful installation.

mobile-safe.description: iPhone/iPad fallback. Avoids Git, desktop-only APIs, and heavy AI/indexing plugins.
